versions.changelog:
- Added Discord support link to contact information.
- Updated supported payment methods: now use GET /payment-methods endpoint, with response including both enabled methods and supported blockchains.
- Clarified browsing and search: search now only returns in-stock items by default.
- Expanded product search parameters to include sorting options (by newest, popular, rating, or price).
- Minor description and compatibility clarifications; removed mention of “AI agents” in favor of “agents”.

No code or documentation changes detected in this release.

- Version bump only; no file or feature updates.

- No file changes were detected in this release.
- No updates to features, documentation, or underlying functionality.
- All previous capabilities and compatibility remain unchanged.

No functional changes in this version.

- No file changes detected compared to previous version.
- Skill functionality, API endpoints, and documentation remain unchanged.

- Added detailed API references: CHECKOUT-FIELDS.md, ERRORS.md, and API.md for better integration and troubleshooting.
- Updated SKILL.md documentation to clarify use cases, search options (`source` support for store/marketplace), and item identification for checkout (productId vs. asin).
- Expanded product and agent compatibility details.
- Improved guidance on marketplace product support and updated when-to-use criteria.
- No functional API changes; documentation and reference improvement release.

Major update: Skill renamed, new AI shopping assistant, x402 autonomous checkout, improved agent compatibility.

- Skill renamed from agentic-commerce-forthecult to shop-culture.
- Adds POST /agent/shop endpoint for natural language shopping assistant (AI suggestions + product lists).
- Introduces x402 autonomous checkout for agent-driven payments (USDC on Solana, no wallet popups required).
- Expanded agent compatibility list, including Cursor, Gemini, Copilot, Windsurf, Goose, and more.
- Removes internal API reference docs (API.md, CHECKOUT-FIELDS.md, ERRORS.md).
- Updated skill description to highlight longevity, smart home, and wellness products.
- Improved and reorganized API workflow documentation for easier agent use.
